spec: Include discoverSegments(dir).invalid.length in the detached-HEAD refusal condition in readOwnManifestChain (packages/gate-manifest/lib/own-chain.mjs) so a detached checkout where manifest.d/ contains only invalid/renamed objects refuses with identityError instead of falling back to root-only.
title: fix(gate-manifest): refuse detached HEAD when manifest.d holds only invalid segment objects (#654)
